verdict.rationale: AngelList's option-exercise docs let admins enable exercises through the platform and link a bank account to the equity plan, which points to online exercise with payment [angellist-docs-9, angellist-docs-10]. Stakeholders can accept issued instruments by e-signature and see their holdings on a dashboard [angellist-docs-17, angellist-docs-16]. The evidence never describes the employee-side exercise flow end to end or confirms that shares are issued automatically after exercise. Missing for 10: an explicit employee-facing exercise walkthrough, confirmation of how payment is processed, documented automatic share issuance after exercise, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
